title: Quality Analyst
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Quality Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the highest standards of quality in our customer service operations. This role involves conducting thorough audits of customer interactions, focusing on voice quality and overall service delivery. The Quality Analyst will work closely with customer support teams to identify areas for improvement and implement quality assurance processes that enhance customer satisfaction. Key responsibilities include performing regular call audits, providing feedback to customer service representatives, and collaborating with management to develop training programs aimed at improving service quality. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively in both English and Spanish. A background in quality assurance within a customer service environment is essential. If you are passionate about quality and customer experience, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: PPI Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Continental develops pioneering technologies and services for sustainable and connected mobility of people and their goods. Founded in 1871, the technology company offers safe, efficient, intelligent and affordable solutions for vehicles, machines, traffic and transportation. In 2021, Continental generated sales of €33.8 billion and currently employs more than 190,000 people in 58 countries and markets. On October 8, 2021, the company celebrated its 150th anniversary. The ContiTech group sector develops and manufactures, for example, cross-material, environmentally friendly and intelligent products and systems for the automotive industry, railway engineering, mining, agriculture and other key industries. Guided by the vision of “smart and sustainable solutions beyond rubber,” the group sector draws on its long-standing knowledge of the industry and materials to open up new business opportunities by combining various materials with electronic components and individual services.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Execute product specific ramp-up or change projects (e.g. team setup, interfacing to business/customer organization, project planning and control, etc.) for e.g. new products, new materials, new equipment or new/relocated production processes according to standards
* participate in preparation of product specific production specifications (i.e. production process characteristics and parameters) according to standards
* update product specific production flow chart, production control plan (in close cooperation with Quality) and work instructions (pre-series, series) according to standards provided by (central) R&D and application engineering
* perform product specific testing and start-up of production process and pre-series production (e.g. ensure run@rate) and handover to production (series) according to standards
* update of product specific process FMEA according to local conditions and standards
* support product specific customer releases (PPAP, e.g. for initial series process or after product or process changes incl. initial sample test report, etc.) according to standards (e.g. trigger matrix)

**Qualifications**
BE, BTech Mechanical, Production, Automotive, Electrical, Telecommunication Engineering
  
  
Experience: 5+ years
  
  
**Additional Information**
Auto CAD, Process design, Engineering Drawing understanding and Process/PPAP documentation
  
  
Ready to drive with Continental? Take the first step and fill in the online application.

title: Lead Specialist
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Assistant / Deputy Manager – Supplier Quality**
.
  
  
In this role you will be responsible for managing and developing safety-critical plastics and painted parts suppliers. You will need to deliver zero-defect performance, drive supplier quality improvements, and ensure compliance with Autoliv standards through effective supplier engagement and strong quality systems.
  
  
Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:
  
  

* Manage serial production issues from suppliers of safety-critical plastics and painted parts
* Drive zero-defect initiatives at supplier processes
* Implement supplier-specific roadmaps within defined timelines
* Approve engineering and process changes as per Autoliv procedures
* Perform root cause analysis and ensure robust corrective actions using 8D methodology
* Conduct supplier audits as per Autoliv, VDA, CQI, and OEM standards
* Drive supplier development initiatives and cultural transformation
* Conduct regular Gemba visits and supplier performance reviews
* Execute PPAP approvals and manage annual re-validation activities
* Ensure safe launch readiness for all supplier changes
* Drive defect reduction, cost optimization, and process improvements
* Implement Lean systems and Poka-Yoke at supplier locations
* Ensure compliance with OEM requirements (MSIL, Honda, VW, Hyundai)
* Lead VAVE and continuous improvement initiatives
* Deploy global lessons learned across local suppliers
* Train suppliers on quality tools, Lean methodologies, and system requirements

**If You Have/are**

* Strong expertise in safety-critical plastics and painting/coating processes
* Hands-on experience in PPAP, Change Management, and supplier quality systems
* Advanced knowledge of quality tools (PFMEA, SPC, MSA)
* IATF Internal Auditor certification (Six Sigma certification preferred)
* Strong experience in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement
* Excellent relationship management skills with internal and external stakeholders
* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Production Engineering (Tooling certification is an advantage)
* 12–15 years of relevant experience in supplier quality (plastics and painted parts)
* Proficiency in English and Kannada (additional languages are a plus)
* Willingness to travel extensively (~75%) across supplier locations

**Competencies & Personal Attributes**

* Add Value, Collaborate, Take Ownership, Make it Easy, Be Curious
* Strong analytical and data-driven mindset
* Ability to influence and motivate supplier performance
* Problem-solving and deep analytical capability

**Additional Information**

* Job Location: Badli
* Reports to: Deputy Manager – Supplier Quality
* High involvement in critical issue resolution
* Extensive supplier visits within India
* Handling customer-specific requirements and audits

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
  
  
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
  
  
**More lives saved – more life lived!**

title: Advanced Specialist - Incoming Quality
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality)**
.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality)**
to join our Quality team. The role is responsible for ensuring supplier part quality, managing incoming inspections, supporting production quality requirements, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in quality inspection, supplier quality management, measurement systems, and problem-solving methodologies within a manufacturing environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Incoming Quality Management
  
  

* Execute incoming material inspections as per defined sampling plans and quality standards.
* Ensure supplier parts meet quality requirements before release to production.
* Develop and maintain part inspection standards and related documentation.
* Monitor incoming quality performance and drive improvement actions.

Supplier Quality Management
  
  

* Investigate supplier-related quality issues and implement containment actions.
* Conduct joint inspections and quality reviews with suppliers.
* Review supplier corrective action plans and 8D reports.
* Raise supplier quality defects in the system and ensure timely closure.

Production Line Support
  
  

* Address line quality concerns related to supplier parts.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Support production teams to minimize quality-related disruptions.

Team & Shift Operations
  
  

* Manage and guide a team of 5-6 inspectors, including supplier representatives.
* Ensure smooth execution of incoming quality activities across shifts.
* Drive inspection strengthening and quality improvement initiatives.

Quality Systems & Reporting
  
  

* Maintain inspection records, rejection reports, dashboards, and PPM data.
* Support customer, system, and internal audits.
* Manage rejection, segregation, material disposition, and supplier returns.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted material flow.

Calibration & Testing
  
  

* Manage calibration of measuring instruments as per schedule.
* Ensure raw material testing activities are completed as planned.
* Maintain compliance with quality standards and procedures.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with measuring instruments such as:

+ Vernier Caliper
+ Micrometer
+ Height Gauge
+ CMM
+ VMM
+ Vision Measurement Systems

* Strong knowledge of engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Understanding of:

+ MSA (Measurement System Analysis)
+ SPC (Statistical Process Control)
+ 7 QC Tools
+ Root Cause Analysis and Problem-Solving Techniques

* Good presentation, reporting, and documentation skills.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Integrity
* Customer Focus
* Accountability
* Execution Excellence
* Collaboration
* Trust Building
* Effective Communication
* Stakeholder Management

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Ethical and professional approach
* Open-minded and adaptable
* Strong observational and analytical skills
* Tactful in handling stakeholders and suppliers
* Versatile and proactive
* Innovative problem solver

**Qualifications**

* BE / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline.

**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Automotive Quality functions.

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
  
  
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.

title: Deputy Manager - Quality (Data Center)
description:
**Job Description**
The Deputy Manager - Quality (ADLEC) will play a pivotal role in controlling and supervising quality assurance processes, working closely with process owners to enhance efficiency and product quality. This role is integral to the company's commitment to delivering high-quality electrical and digital systems, and the successful candidate will have a direct impact on the company's reputation and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and build effective quality processes within the organization and work with all process owners to remove bottlenecks.
* Understand test methods and the operation of testing equipment.
* Conduct product and process audits and plan daily inspection activities to thoroughly inspect final products and components.
* Ensure effective quality-checking activities to prevent errors in subsequent processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis for product quality issues and present findings to senior management.
* Conduct stage-wise verification to check compliance with stated requirements and analyze stage-wise rejection to control CONQ and first-hand rejections.
* Provide quick and effective solutions to quality issues.
* Manage field returns and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure timely analysis and resolution of customer complaints.
* Carry out calibration activities and ensure all instruments are calibrated on time.
* Track quality measures and achieve targets for first-hand rejections, cost of non-quality, customer returns index, instrument calibration, and other relevant measures.
* Conduct monthly SGIA audits and work toward achieving productivity targets.
* Support Production and other teams on a daily basis to ensure product quality.
* Train, develop, and coach team members, keeping them updated on the latest developments in the QA field.
* Handle customers during product inspections, compliance follow-ups, and factory assessments/evaluations.
* Prepare Manufacturing Control Plans.
* Demonstrate good communication skills and coordinate/collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Maintain good knowledge of electrical switchgear/switchboards and applicable IS/IEC standards.

**Qualifications**
**Functional Competencies**
Understanding of product standards
  
  
Knowledge of manufacturing processes
  
  
Awareness of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, TQM, etc.
  
  
Planning and organizing skills
  
  
Product qualification, PPAP, and PFMEA tools
  
  
**Qualifications, Role-specific Knowledge And Experience**
Diploma/BE/B.Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering.
  
  
7+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry.
  
  
At least 2–3 years of experience in process, product, and quality system audits.
  
  
Quality certifications such as ISO, TQM, Six Sigma, etc.
  
  
ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 Internal Auditor certification would be an added advantage.
  
  
Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools.
  
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

title: Solution Consultant – Global Consulting Hub
description:
**Role Overview**
The Solution Consultant – Global Consulting will implement Basware solutions for customers, ensuring adherence to country-specific requirements while delivering seamless AP automation. The role spans design, build, testing, and post-go-live support, requiring strong implementation expertise and customer engagement skills.
  
  
**Compliance Focus**
This role demands a proactive approach to regulatory compliance, ensuring that all configurations, integrations, and workflows meet local statutory requirements such as e-invoicing, e-reporting, and tax mandates. The consultant will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through compliance best practices while embedding these requirements into the solution design and delivery process.
  
  
**Design Phase**

* Analyse existing integration rules and formats.
* Design field updates and mapping for AP Automation and Network integrations.
* Support API notification and E-Reporting content mapping.

**Build & SIT (System Integration Testing)**

* Configure invoicing addresses, endpoints, and entity settings in Network and AP Automation
* Update import configuration files and mapping for new fields and business rules.
* Execute end-to-end testing, document findings, and propose resolutions.
* Implement E-Invoicing, lifecycle setup, E-Reporting, Directory API, and portal entity registration.

**UAT (User Acceptance Testing)**

* Prepare test scenarios and plans.
* Support customer UAT, identify defects, and document findings.
* Analyse issues, develop fixes, and ensure resolution documentation.

**Move to Production**

* Prepare and execute Go-Live activities.
* Ensure smooth transition and readiness for production.

**Hypercare (Post-Go-Live Support)**

* Provide support for reported issues during Hypercare phases.
* Identify and resolve defects, document resolutions, and ensure system stability.

,
  
  

* Flexible shift timings\*

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven experience as an Implementation or Solution Consultant in ERP/AP automation projects.
* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes and workflows.
* Hands-on experience with system configuration, data mapping, and integration (APIs, SFTP, REST).
* Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and reporting frameworks.
* Ability to manage workshops, testing phases, and customer training.
* Strong documentation and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of implementation experience in ERP or AP automation projects.
* Experience with Basware or similar AP automation platforms.
* Exposure to multi-country implementations with varying compliance mandates.
* Knowledge of digital and custom delivery methodologies.
* Experience with AI tools, frameworks, or applications is considered a strong asset.

We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning.
